description: Staff information security handbook of a fictional institute with 22 unnumbered sections, typeset with reportlab (Liberation Serif body, Liberation Sans headings, footer "Page N"). In the new version the section "Reporting a security incident" was moved from near the end to third place, and "Removable media" was moved down four sections to follow "Video calls and meetings"; inside the moved incident section the reporting deadline changed. Elsewhere the minimum passphrase length changed, one sentence was deleted, one sentence was made bold, and a service name was replaced. All other sections are unchanged and keep their relative order; their page positions change only as a consequence of the moves. Producer: reportlab 5 (platypus), Liberation Serif/Sans.
